messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — AcmeHealth is saying they won't sign off on MVP launch next Wed unless we have tenant-level SSO + audit logs. They called it "dealbreaker".

Mike Chen: That's...rough. Full SAML + audit pipeline is ~2w of focused eng (auth + test infra). Is there room to narrow scope to OIDC only?

Priya Singh: We can push commercial hold but it will delay others. Acme is top-10 ARR and likely to convert early if we deliver quickly.

Sam Ortiz: Design: if we limit to OIDC redirect + basic SCIM later, we can hide the provisioning screens and ship.

Leo Park: For Private deployments, SAML is more common. If we ship OIDC now, we should add a networked flag so Private tenants get the fallback to manual provisioning.

Jenna Wu: Sales notes: Acme is okay with a 2-week timeline if we include a delivered milestone and legal addendum. They prefer we don't delay GA.

Aisha Patel: Options I see:
1) Delay GA by 2w and include full SAML+audit (risk: momentum)
2) Ship GA without SSO, promise fast follow-up for Acme (risk: lose the deal)
3) Ship OIDC minimal path + canary to Acme (compromise)

Mike Chen: I vote 3. Rough plan:
```
- Spike: 2d to confirm libs + IdP flows
- Implement: 3 engs x 8d for OIDC + tests
- Canary: 1 week with Acme only
- Follow-up SAML: separate sprint
```

Priya Singh: If we go canary, I can coordinate legal addendum + support runbook.

Sam Ortiz: I'll mock the minimal screens today and handoff tomorrow.

Leo Park: Need infra checklist for telemetry + audit logs (even minimal). I'll draft.

Jenna Wu: I'll get confirmation from Acme that they're happy with canary/OIDC path and document acceptance criteria.

Aisha Patel: Sounds like we have momentum for option 3. @Mike Chen can you own eng plan? @Jenna Wu please get written OK from Acme by EOD. Everyone add blockers here.

Mike Chen: On it. Starting a short project board and will post link.

Jenna Wu: Acme legal ok verbally, sending email now.

release-bot: deploy scheduled for canary channel: feature/oidc-canary -> staging at 2024-12-01T10:00Z

Sam Ortiz: +1 :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Adding tasks to launch checklist.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — we'll treat this as a soft-launch for Acme and keep GA date but flag the GA release notes that full SAML/audit will come in v1. If anything changes, ping me.
